units.source_text: 波特莱尔成为白痴之后，他的人生观只用这个词来表达，即“女阴”。

en.t: After Baudelaire became an idiot, his view of life was expressed by this one word alone: "female genitals."

units.source_text: 不过这个词并不足以评价他。

en.t: But this word is not enough to judge him.

units.source_text: 能评论他是不如说是“诗才”，他靠诗才就能够维持生活，所以他忘了“肚皮”这个词。

en.t: What truly characterizes him is, rather, his "poetic talent"; because he could make a living by that talent, he forgot the word "belly."
